text: {"decision": "reject", "reason": "ExcerptPostId semantically references a tag-excerpt post (its values pair consecutively with WikiPostId, e.g. 65334/65333, as posts do), and the 0.829 containment is indistinguishable from the ~0.79 chance overlap expected for arbitrary integers in comments' dense 1–221292 ID space, with only 0.3% coverage of comments."}
